perspectives.summary: Phase 2 addresses three concrete decoupling targets with measurable edges. Container/MCP coupling is already partially mitigated by composition-root but residual edges remain, especially container/adapters.ts importing mcp/gateway-ws.ts. GatewayDeps is a 17-method fat interface consumed differently by each health endpoint. craft-catalog and catalog-loader form a type/runtime cycle and 18 eager const exports break reloadCatalog semantics.
key_points: container/gateway-control-plane.ts is a re-export shim; point gateway-bootstrap.ts to composition-root
WorkflowEventRelay in container/adapters.ts should be abstracted behind container-level interface
GatewayDeps should be split into role-specific interfaces while keeping a backward-compatible alias
craft-catalog should extract types to craft-types.ts and convert const exports to lazy getters
